name: Memories Of Zattera
detailed_description:
"Fragments of the past weave together, each memory unveiling a hidden truth, each detail blurring the line between reality and mere perception."

For a decade, the arcane kingdom of Ahlfar, blessed by ancient magic and guide by the stars, clashed with Kyrguios, a nation powered by science and invention. Their final war was unlike any before it: Kyrguios unleashed cutting-edge warships and bold strategies, delivering a crushing blow that shattered Ahlfar’s faith in its centuries-old arcane traditions.

In the aftermath of defeat, as tensions simmer and rebuilding begins, Ahlfar’s king dared to learn from the very force that overcame them. Now, the royal family stands at a crossroads: adhere to ancient customs or embrace Kyrguios’s pragmatic innovation.
Who could have imagined a mechanical cannon surpassing the fiery might of a seasoned mage’s spell?

Explore Moral & Political Dilemmas in a Fantasy Universe

Explore the collision of magic and technology, tradition and innovation. Will you champion the starlit legacy of Ahlfar or spark a new era with Kyrguios’s progress?

Connect with an Engaging Cast and Forge Meaningful Relationships

Meet memorable heroes and adversaries whose bonds grow as you progress. Every interaction can spark friendship, rivalry, or something in between.

Experience a Story Crafted for Multiple Playthroughs

Each perspective uncovers hidden truths and deeper layers of the story. Return with fresh insights to experience entirely new outcomes.

Unlock Multiple Perspectives and Characters

Switch between distinct characters, each offering a unique lens on the world and its secrets. Shape the narrative by forging alliances, challenging rivals, or embracing unexpected paths.

Dare to Rethink Everything You Knew?

In a realm woven from fragmented recollections and shifting viewpoints, each memory you unlock reveals a deeper truth. Dare to reshape your perspective and discover who you really are?

Immerse yourself in Memories of Zattera (MoZ), a viewpoint-focused visual novel with a rich fantasy lore. Teaser Demo available now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or later
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 or DirectX 11 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: 2.2 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or newer integrated GPU (OpenGL 3.0 / DirectX 11)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.10 (Yosemite) or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz 64-bit Intel-compatible (Apple Silicon supported via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 (Mojave) or later
  • Processor: 2.2 GHz 64-bit Intel-compatible (Apple Silicon supported via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 or Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or equivalent (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Dual-Core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible (dedicated or newer integrated GPU)
